reassessment_reason: The September assessment predates the existing 42-field offline company-family parser. Local schema implementation is now evidenced; this does not establish source-data possession, current schema continuity, subscription authority, or production readiness.

access.bulk: The official service offers monthly All Companies and daily/weekly new-company files plus daily company changes, subject to subscriber access.
access.api: No supported credentialless bulk read API was established.
access.search: Public entity search is separate from bulk subscription.
access.fees: Business records for commercial use cost $2,000/month. Noncommercial monthly fees are waived, but registration and a Subscriber Agreement remain required.

fields.summary: The official page links the company-layout XLS. The existing local offline contract defines 42 tab-delimited fields, composite ID/comptype/compseq, independent recordnumber, native Status/Standing/Type, dates, and principal-office ZIP. This review verified the link and inspected the implementation; it did not reparse the current workbook or inspect publisher rows.

active_status_semantics: The offline parser retains Status A/D/I and Standing G/B/X without inferring current operation. All Companies includes registry filings, not a verified active-establishment census. A production status mapping remains unapproved.
statewide_completeness: The product is described as all companies on file with the Secretary of State; registry coverage is not complete coverage of operating businesses, and no current control total or verified retained source release was established.
address_zip: The implemented projection retains principal administrative address and separately parsed ZIP5/ZIP4 only. Such addresses may be residential or outside Kentucky and are not physical operating sites. Registered-agent and applicant fields are excluded.
automation_terms_fees: Registration and a Subscriber Agreement are explicit prerequisites, including for noncommercial use. Unattended transfer support and the applicable unsigned agreement were not established; no account, agreement or payment is authorized.
redistribution: Public layout documentation and the offline parser grant no dataset redistribution, publication or geocoding rights. Raw company files remain person-bearing/internal and the minimized projection remains local-review-only under the existing policy.
temporal_refresh: Published monthly full and daily/weekly incremental frequencies are known. Deletions, replay, recovery, header/encoding continuity, provider checksums and source-control totals are not verified.

citations.evidence: Current subscription, agreement, commercial/noncommercial fees and bulk product availability.
Monthly and incremental tab-delimited company families and officer linkage.
Official linked schema document; current workbook contents were not reparsed in this review.

strongest_next_action: Retain the existing offline fixture boundary and reconcile assessment evidence with its implemented schema. A future authorized subscription review must resolve source authenticity, rights and transfer terms. Do not acquire, contact, enroll, pay, accept terms, automate, or change production from this reassessment.
